attributes.description: FinOps visibility into Elastic Synthetics SKU billing, per-monitor check executions, reliability, and synthetics-* data stream footprint.

params.markdown:
# Synthetics FinOps
Tracks Elastic Synthetics SKU billing alongside per-monitor check volume, availability, observer locations, and Synthetics data stream footprint.

query.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL
| EVAL sku_l = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(sku, "")), ct_l = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(cost_type, ""))
| WHERE ct_l == "synthetics" OR sku_l LIKE "*synthetic*" 
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, deployment = CASE(deployment_id IS NULL, COALESCE(deployment_name, "unknown"), CONCAT(COALESCE(deployment_name, deployment_id), " (", LEFT(deployment_id, 6), ")"))
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), currency_unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"))
| STATS `Normalized cost` = ROUND(SUM(total_chargeable_units * rate), 2) BY ts, deployment
| RENAME ts AS `@timestamp`
| SORT `@timestamp` ASC
| LIMIT 10000

query.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.cluster_synthetics_monitor_contribution
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND monitor_id IS NOT NULL
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, s_dep_id = deployment_id, s_dep_name = deployment_name
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, deployment_name, deployment_group, @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.billing_realized_pool ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, false),
       ping_pool_units = COALESCE(synthetics_pings_units, 0.0),
       exec_pool_units = COALESCE(synthetics_executions_units, 0.0),
       tot_pool_units = COALESCE(synthetics_chargeable_units, 0.0)
| EVAL deployment = COALESCE(s_dep_name, deployment_name, s_dep_id, deployment_id, "unknown"),
       mon_name = COALESCE(monitor_name, monitor_id),
       mon_ns = COALESCE(monitor_namespace, "default"),
       is_ping = (COALESCE(monitor_type, "http") != "browser")
| EVAL cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol, cloud_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, onprem_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, onprem_sym = conf_currency_symbol, onprem_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP onprem_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit
| EVAL _c_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), _c_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)), null), _o_has_row = (onprem_rate IS NOT NULL), _o_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_unit)), null), _o_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)), null)
| EVAL _c_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0 AND (_c_sym_u IS NULL OR _c_sym_u == COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR")), TRIM(cloud_sym), null), _o_eff_u = COALESCE(_o_unit, _c_unit, "EUR")
| EVAL _o_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym)) > 0 AND (_o_sym_u IS NULL OR _o_sym_u == _o_eff_u), TRIM(onprem_sym), null), rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(onprem_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, _o_eff_u, COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR"))
| EVAL _def_sym = CASE(unit == "USD", "$", unit == "GBP", "£", unit == "ZAR", "R", "€")
| EVAL sym = CASE(is_onprem_row, CASE(_o_sym IS NOT NULL, _o_sym, _o_has_row AND _o_unit IS NULL AND _c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _c_sym IS NOT NULL AND _c_unit == unit, _c_sym, _def_sym), CASE(_c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _def_sym))
| EVAL Currency = CONCAT(sym, " ", unit),
       ping_pool = ping_pool_units * rate,
       exec_pool = exec_pool_units * rate,
       tot_pool = tot_pool_units * rate
| STATS day_chk = SUM(TO_LONG(COALESCE(check_count, 0))),
        day_up = SUM(TO_LONG(COALESCE(up_count, 0))),
        day_down = SUM(TO_LONG(COALESCE(down_count, 0))),
        day_loc = MAX(TO_LONG(COALESCE(locations_count, 1))),
        day_dur_ms = SUM(TO_DOUBLE(COALESCE(total_duration_ms, average_duration_ms * TO_DOUBLE(check_count), 0.0))),
        day_avg_ms = AVG(TO_DOUBLE(COALESCE(average_duration_ms, 0.0)))
  BY ck, deployment, mon_name, monitor_type, mon_ns, is_ping, Currency, ping_pool, exec_pool, tot_pool
| INLINE STATS dep_ping_chk = SUM(CASE(is_ping, day_chk, 0)), dep_exec_chk = SUM(CASE(NOT is_ping, day_chk, 0)), dep_all_chk = SUM(day_chk) BY ck
| EVAL spec_ping_alloc = CASE(dep_ping_chk > 0, ping_pool, 0.0),
       spec_exec_alloc = CASE(dep_exec_chk > 0, exec_pool, 0.0)
| EVAL unmatched_pool = CASE(tot_pool > (spec_ping_alloc + spec_exec_alloc), tot_pool - spec_ping_alloc - spec_exec_alloc, 0.0),
       chk = TO_DOUBLE(day_chk)
| EVAL row_cost = (
         CASE(
           is_ping AND dep_ping_chk > 0, ping_pool * chk / TO_DOUBLE(dep_ping_chk),
           NOT is_ping AND dep_exec_chk > 0, exec_pool * chk / TO_DOUBLE(dep_exec_chk),
           0.0
         ) + CASE(dep_all_chk > 0, unmatched_pool * chk / TO_DOUBLE(dep_all_chk), 0.0)
       )
| STATS `Checks` = SUM(day_chk), `Up` = SUM(day_up), `Down` = SUM(day_down), `Locations` = MAX(day_loc), s_dur = SUM(day_dur_ms), a_dur = AVG(day_avg_ms), `Attributed Cost` = ROUND(SUM(row_cost), 2) BY deployment, mon_name, monitor_type, mon_ns, Currency
| EVAL `Avg Duration (ms)` = ROUND(CASE(`Checks` > 0, s_dur / TO_DOUBLE(`Checks`), a_dur), 2)
| RENAME deployment AS `Deployment`, mon_name AS `Monitor`, monitor_type AS `Type`, mon_ns AS `Namespace`
| KEEP `Deployment`, `Monitor`, `Type`, `Namespace`, `Currency`, `Checks`, `Up`, `Down`, `Locations`, `Avg Duration (ms)`, `Attributed Cost`
| SORT `Attributed Cost` DESC, `Checks` DESC
| LIMIT 5000

FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_realized_pool, chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution METADATA _index
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND composite_key IS NOT NULL
| EVAL ck = composite_key::keyword, dep_name_cand = CASE(deployment_name IS NOT NULL AND deployment_name != "", deployment_name, null), dep_id_cand = deployment_id
| STATS m_dep_name = MV_MAX(VALUES(dep_name_cand)), m_dep_id = MV_MAX(VALUES(dep_id_cand)) BY ck
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_datastream_contribution ON ck == composite_key
| WHERE ds_type == "synthetics" OR STARTS_WITH(COALESCE(datastream, ""), "synthetics-")
| EVAL deployment = COALESCE(m_dep_name, m_dep_id, deployment_id, cluster_name, "unknown")
| STATS `Storage (GiB)` = ROUND(AVG(TO_DOUBLE(COALESCE(datastream_sum_data_set_store_size, 0))) / 1073741824.0, 3), `Indexing (ms)` = SUM(COALESCE(datastream_sum_indexing_time, 0)), `Query (ms)` = SUM(COALESCE(datastream_sum_query_time, 0)) BY deployment, datastream, ds_namespace
